{{Quote|I have a very bad feeling about this.|C-3PO|<ref name="Glove" />}}
The '''Mission to Kessel''' was a mission undertaken by [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] at the beginning of the [[Trioculus]] affair.

==Background==
===A shattered Empire===
{{Quote|After Palpatine's fiery death<br />Another leader soon comes to command the Empire<br />And on his right hand he does wear<br />The glove of Darth Vader!|Prophecy from Kadann's imposter|<ref name="Glove" />}}
[[File:Trioculus2.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Central Committee of Grand Moffs planned to reveal Trioculus (pictured), the alleged son of Palpatine, in a ceremony on Kessel.]]
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The loss of the Emperor and the second [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star]] resulted in a victory for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] that shattered the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] leadership and allowed the Alliance to transform into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Various Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] fought for control of the remnants, including a power struggle between [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Director of Imperial Intelligence|Director]] [[Ysanne Isard]] and the [[Central Committee of Grand Moffs]].<ref name="NEC" />

Interim [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] approached former [[Prophets of the Dark Side|prophet of the Dark Side]] [[Cronal]] to introduce the [[Church of the Dark Side]] as a new state religion. The real prophets, including their [[Supreme Prophet]] [[Kadann]], had disappeared after a falling out with Palpatine, so Cronal hired a [[Bimm/Legends|Bimm]] actor named [[Rajah Ubooki]] to pose as Kadann and make regular [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] appearances where he presented cryptic prophecies.<ref name="SPIN">{{SW|url=news/the-star-wars-spy-game-spin-declassified|text=The ''Star Wars'' Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|int=The Star Wars Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|nolive=1}}</ref> One such prediction was that a new emperor would rise, wearing the indestructible [[Glove of Darth Vader]], which had been thought to be lost in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] after the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] amputated Vader's [[Limb/Legends|hand]] in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] aboard the Death Star.<ref name="Glove" /> The [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] chose to move against Isard by selecting their own candidate for the Imperial throne,<ref name="NEC" /> a three-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] [[Trioculus]], a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] lord from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] who was believed to be the [[Reproduction/Legends|son]] of Palpatine.<ref name="Glove" />

===Droid spies===
{{Quote|Thousands of grand moffs, evil warlords, stormtroopers, Imperial droids, and enemy officers from the Empire are arriving at Kessendra Stadium on Kessel for a big gathering in their capital city.|Mon Mothma|<ref name="Glove" />}}
[[File:Droid_Repair_shop.png|thumb|left|300px|Luke Skywalker and C-3PO prepare for the mission]]
The New Republic [[Senate Planetary Intelligence Network]] heard Kadann's prophecies and intelligence of a large Imperial [[Kessendra Coronation|gathering]] occurring in [[Kessendra Stadium]] on Kessel.<ref name="Glove" /> SPIN agent and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was considered too well known to work as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]], so his [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were selected instead, but they were still considered too recognizable and had to be disguised.<ref name="SPIN" /> At the [[Droid Repair Shop (Yavin 4)|Droid Repair Shop]] on the New Republic base on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], the [[Droid Modification Team]] disguised R2-D2 as a [[Color/Legends|dark green]] [[Kesselian spice-mining droid]] with a modified dome, and C-3PO as a green [[Kesselian security droid]] with a new evil-looking head. R2-D2 was pleased with his modifications, while C-3PO protested about his to Skywalker. The Jedi transported the droids in an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] to the [[Palace of the Woolamander]], the seat of the New Republic [[New Republic Provisional Council|Senate]], where<ref name="Glove" /> [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]]<ref name="SPIN" /> [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] was to give a briefing on the droids' undercover mission, which was attended by New Republic heroes [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].<ref name="Glove" />

After Skywalker and Solo discussed the severe punishments for New Republic sympathizers on Kessel, Mothma shared SPIN's intelligence about the gathering on Kessel and the imposter Kadann's prophecy. She also explained that intelligence reports showed that Vader's glove had not been found, but speculated that an Imperial may have been preparing to reveal it on Kessel. Via [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]], Mothma showed a [[Drop pod/Legends|drop pod]] engineered by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] and his fellow [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] had engineered to resemble a [[Meteorite/Legends|meteor]]. Calrissian was already receiving a ride to the planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] from Solo, and so he offered to eject the drop pod from Solo's [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], en route. The pod was designed to shed its disguise to resemble a spherical Imperial [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]], which the droids would use to fly to Kessel's upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] to a stolen Imperial [[Command Speeder 714-D]] for their escape.

When C-3PO became agitated at the prospect of getting lost on Kessel, Mothma reminded him that R2-D2's data banks were loaded with maps of Kessel based on intelligence from an escaped slave, showing the layout of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kessendra]] and its [[Kessendra Stadium|Stadium]], including a secret escape tunnel. Mothma concluded the briefing and asked those present to [[Sleep/Legends|rest]] well in the [[Standard day/Legends|night]] before the mission. C-3PO nervously asked Skywalker if there was no one more suited to the mission, to which the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] responded that the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] had already calculated that a [[Human/Legends|Human]] or [[Alien/Legends|alien]] Alliance sympathizer had only a one in 12600 chance in returning from Kessel.<ref name="Glove" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|I certainly hope we get back to Yavin 4. Master Luke is going to blow a short circuit when he hears the news about the Emperor's son!|C-3PO, to [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]|<ref name="Glove" />}}
R2-D2 and C-3PO were disguised as Kesselian droids (as they were far too well known to afford undergoing the mission as-is) and landed on the planet in a [[Drop pod/Legends|drop pod]] covered as a meteor. They reached the capital [[Kessendra]] and the [[Kessendra Stadium|Stadium]] where took place the meeting.

[[File:KessendraStadium-GoDV.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The Imperial convocation at the Kessendra Stadium]]
During the convocation, [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Bertroff Hissa|Hissa]] [[Kessendra Coronation|presented]] the [[Supreme Slavelord]] [[Trioculus]] as the son of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Trioculus declared himself the rightful ruler of the Empire and demonstrated his power by blasting a critical [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] and [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guard]] with a lethal dose of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]].

After the meeting, the two droids tried to escape the planet but their transport was detected and destroyed by Imperial [[LAVr QH-7 Chariot/Legends|LAVr QH-7 Chariots]]. They were about to be located by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] when they were rescued by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. The trio reached the Stolen Imperial [[Command Speeder 714-D]] used by the Jedi to land on Kessel. Pursued by Imperial Chariots, the ship piloted by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] managed to leave the surface, destroying some enemy speeders on its way. In orbit, the speeder was detected by [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] but they eventually managed to escape in a radioactive [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]].

==Aftermath==
After the mission, the New Republic agents traveled to [[Dac/Legends|Calamari]] in order to lure any potential pursuer far away from the SPIN headquarters on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].
